items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Edmond Jones was on 'Too Late' and the interviewee corrects him saying 'that's you on 'Too Late'', implying they are different people on the same recording session, but no personal interaction is described.

ctx.x: They've got that thing all screwed up. I was on "Too Late."
Oh, you were on "Too Late." They have here Edmond Jones was on "Too Late," but that's you on "Too Late."
